description: Accidentes de Tránsito registrados en el municipio de Fusagasugá is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía de Fusagasugá, Cundinamarca. La Secretaría de Movilidad de la Alcaldía del municipio de Fusagasugá da a conocer la base de datos de los Accidentes de Tránsito que han sido registrados en los Informes Policiales de Accidentes de Tránsito (IPAT), fecha de corte del 29 de abril de 2026. Coverage: Alcaldía de Fusagasugá, Cundinamarca. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía de Fusagasugá, Cundinamarca. Its tags are movilidad, accidentes de transito, municipio de fusagasugá, fusagasugá. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Transporte. The portal shows 2026-06-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
